name: 30642 · Greensboro, GA
findings: ZIP 30642 (Greensboro) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30642 (Greensboro) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30642 (Greensboro) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
